messages:
Nina (AE): AstraDynamics POC ask: SAML SSO, SCIM users+groups, RBAC mapping, and domain verification for tenant-lock. They want Dedicated vs Private pricing and a short SLA for auth handoff. Need reply by EOD Thurs. Any quick blockers?

Tom (SE): We support IdP/SP SAML. Ask for IdP metadata (XML/url), NameID preference, group claim key and whether they need encrypted assertions.

Hana (Security): Questionnaire items: require RSA-SHA256, SCIM over TLS1.2+, SCIM auth via OAuth2 client_credentials with 90d rotation, audit logs 180d. Legal wants SOC2 + a DPA for Private.

Carlos (Eng): SCIM: full import + delta sync supported. Default rate-limit 50 req/min; can bump for Dedicated POC. Bulk CSV/SFTP import available for initial seed but group mapping required separately. Example SCIM user we accept: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"rachel@astra.com","externalId":"ad-77"}
